claims.claim: The committed candidate changes exactly the four authorized files. Local-chat-wake implementation/tests, lifecycle artifacts, and roadmap state remain unchanged.

Default output retains the ordinary five-field result contract. Existing predicate ordering, three-second READY window, 50 ms cadence, challenge TTL, exact-text grammar, registry attempt pipeline, and consume-before-single-click behavior are preserved.

Explicit --diagnostic wraps the ordinary result with INSERT/READY attribution, closed blocking categories and proof subcategories, bounded booleans, and at most seven observed gate enums. Attribution uses the existing predicate evaluation without another DOM pass or attempt and exports no raw identity, content, timestamps, or exception strings.

Deterministic regression definitions compare both modes against frozen TASK-297 predicates and assert matching decisions, predicate-call order, waits, mutation/click counts, status/reason, and registry semantics. Coverage includes insert rejection, required READY gates, timeout, success, ambiguity/no-resend, and the synthetic literal-paste/BR fixture with length 271 and newline runs 47/5, 75/2, and 245/2.

H4C0 documentation records the supplied post-TASK-297 instrumented observations, explicitly retracts timeout/selector fixes as unproven, defines TASK-298 as diagnostic-only, and retains H4C0 open/H4C1 blocked pending later Human/Brain observation and semantic decision.
